title: Raise the fixed F4 coordinate query-rank floor to 24 (no κ)
body:
## Summary

Prove a new scoped obstruction for the fixed four-coordinate F4 root-ray decoder, strengthening Ali Romman's PR6512:

```diff
- each coordinate query has fitting rank at least 5; total floor 20
+ each coordinate query has fitting rank at least 6; total floor 24
```

The written proof works over every field, permits arbitrary nonzero diagonal and nonsymmetric fitting matrices, and gives separate rank-power charges at least `4*6^t` for every `t>0`. A nine-ray forcing argument rules out rank five after normalizing a forced I5 minor. This is a **scoped written proof with exhaustive finite corroboration**, not a new κ or a complete multiplication theorem.

Only `research/f4-coordinate-rank-floor/` is added. This contribution was produced by Nick Petalas. Credit Ali Romman for PR6512's model and rank-five bound, DreamingOfClouds for PR2125's earlier F4 cost-24 search across bases, Aaron Wang for PR2272/2518's distinct fixed-pairing screens, and the retained root-unit, Cinna Davis path-caller and Jacob Alan Sussman productive-recursion lineage. Rank factorization and zero-pattern arguments are classical. No predecessor verifier or caller invoice is replayed as the deliverable.

[Advance CLAIM](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166#discussioncomment-19380487). Canonical base and submission refresh are `7c49fe32c55de02c2c873655c804b16e4c3fef0a`, priority revision 8, selected PR6030. Live claims and PRs, main object/formula/general-form searches, merged work and local reservations were checked. Sparse cached notes, arbitrary diffs and unpublished work remain coverage limits.

## Evidence

Before, the five-clique bound allowed rank five per coordinate. After, the new nine-ray proof excludes it. The checker independently generates the 24 real rays and verifies all four coordinate embeddings. Every one of the 262,144 binary fitting matrices on the nine-ray support is enumerated, including asymmetric choices, and two elimination methods agree throughout. The exact rank counts are 321 at rank 6, 21,497 at rank 7, 148,302 at rank 8 and 92,024 at rank 9.

All 36 possible binary rank-five factor tuples reject: the first violated constraint is a/u in 30 cases, b/v in five, and a/b in one. A relaxed zero-pair fixture has rank five; three invalid-input controls reject. Generated stdout receipts bind the six package-file hashes to these executed results. No receipt is handwritten.

CPython 3.12.15, macOS arm64, standard library only. From the repository root:

```sh
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B -W error research/f4-coordinate-rank-floor/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -O -B -W error research/f4-coordinate-rank-floor/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/f4-coordinate-rank-floor
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/f4-coordinate-rank-floor --check-source-history
```

Another CPython 3.12 interpreter can replace that absolute path. All commands pass locally. Normal and optimized direct checks took 1.20 and 1.22 seconds; the registered normal/optimized package run took 2.64 seconds. Both commands have 120-second timeouts. Expected markers are `PASS_F4_COORDINATE_RANK_SIX`, `PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE` and `PASS_RESEARCH_COMMIT_BYTES`.

The official committed-byte export and input-coverage check pass. Normal and optimized replay also pass from a read-only Git-free export with `PATH=/nonexistent`, in 1.26 and 1.27 seconds; all seven exported files retain their hashes and modes. Full declared source ancestry passes. No imported predecessor program, solver or network is needed for the scientific replay.

## Limitations

The theorem fixes the coordinate Gram factors and separate query charges. Other bases, rectangular decoders, shared delivery, productive helper credit and complete native/caller invoices are outside its scope. The rank-six witness is only for the nine-ray subproblem. No full 15-ray rank-six completion or common 24-ray attaining matrix is claimed. The all-field quantifier comes from the written proof, not a finite field census.

Independent human and formal proof-kernel review are unclaimed. Selected cold replay, native/compiler/precision/tape/stock obligations, supplier admission and all-size multiplication remain unrun or unresolved. No selected-frontier change is requested.

## Open next questions

- Can a common full 24-ray binary fitting matrix attain rank six in all four coordinate blocks? Start by completing the reported nine-ray witness on each 15-ray support. No such common completion is supplied.
- Can a changed basis or shared query contract evade this floor and win the complete signed invoice? First specify an exact decomposition and price every delivery and restoration cost. No such physical consumer is constructed here.

## Related open work

The final account-open-PR refresh found no additional study of this F4 coordinate-decoder object among the seven open PRs created since the advance CLAIM.

- [PR6512](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/6512), Ali Romman: the same fixed-coordinate F4 object and its path-caller invoice. This adds a new all-field rank-six obstruction beyond its rank-five minors. Its caller bounds and numerical margins are cited, not rechecked; this PR does not assert an optimal caller or a new full-invoice margin.

## CI notes

CI did not certify this result at head `3bf7fb018cc6b4751f75309d7775eeb0d32d3b48`. In [run 41692390767](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/41692390767), the `plan` job started at 18:17:37Z and was cancelled at 18:27:39Z by the workflow's 10-minute timeout while still in `actions/checkout`. Python setup, onboarding tests and package selection did not run; `replay (research/f4-coordinate-rank-floor)` was skipped. This is a checkout infrastructure timeout, not a package-check failure.

The result is certified only by the local checks listed under Evidence: direct and registered normal/optimized scientific replay, metadata and source pins, committed bytes/source history, official export/input coverage, and read-only Git-free normal/optimized replay. No hosted scientific replay or independent human/proof-kernel acceptance is claimed. No commit or workflow rerun was used to retrigger CI.

An [earlier run today](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/41670552412/job/126037441478) likewise cancelled `plan` during `actions/checkout`, from 16:05:23Z to 16:15:28Z, with replay skipped. Its job metadata was checked; no claim is made about other failures.

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way. The six-file research package is isolated and removable.

**Blast Radius:** package. No shared code, predecessor artifact, selected record or frozen input changes.
